full_script: The proof of knowledge is demonstration. Keep quiet and let that sink into your marrow. My mentor taught me that the chronic suffering of humanity is the fallacy of thinking: 'I could do it if I wanted to.' But until you do it and finish it, nobody knows that you know it. You are not a master cobbler until you produce a shoe that does not fall apart before the owner reaches the street corner. Ancient Greek philosophers conceived grand thoughts, but they did not settle hospital bills with contemplation. Do not confuse your temporary destination with your ultimate destiny. Adaptation is the true mark of intelligence. Either demonstrate your competence today, or retire quietly into intellectual arrogance.
